title: SAM & MAX HIT THE ROAD
subtitle: LucasArts, 1993 · the demo, on ScummVM 0.6.1's SCUMM engine (v6)
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its name. Other switches of 0.6.1: -g<scaler> (normal, 2x, 3x, 2xsai, super2xsai, supereagle, advmame2x, advmame3x, hq2x, hq3x, tv2x, dotmatrix), -f for full screen, -m<volume> for the music, -s<volume> for the sound effects, -n for no subtitles.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: samnmax-dos-demo-en.zip as the ScummVM project distributes it (downloads.scummvm.org/frs/demos/scumm/), unpacked in the page

_why: SCUMM v6, the engine of Day of the Tentacle, with its iMUSE music. Held to a native g++ build frame by frame (gate-scummvm).
_shipped: The same program as scummvm-samnmax.json, with its data the demo archive ScummVM hosts, passed on whole and unpacked in the page: what the static export ships (tools/site-programs.json).
